allow: PowerShell($conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5190 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conns\) { $conns | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "killing PID $_"; Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } else { Write-Output "nothing listening on 5190" })
